stem: One explant type establishes reliably while another browns and fails under the same medium. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Explant type and developmental state can influence establishment and should be analyzed separately
The failed explants prove the medium is universally unsuitable
All explants from one donor must respond identically
Only vessel size can explain the difference
rationale: Cannabis in-vitro response can vary by tissue type and developmental state, so establishment should be evaluated by explant and genotype.
